===Starting the quest===
{{Checklist|
*Travel to the [[Ruins of Uzer]] via the [[necklace of passage]] teleport to [[Eagle's Eyrie]] and run south-east. You can alternatively use a fairy ring ({{Fairycode|DLQ}}) and go north-east.
*Pick up and read the [[Letter (The Golem)|Letter]] west of the broken [[clay golem]]
*Talk to the golem. {{Chat option|1Shall I try to repair you?}}
*Use four [[soft clay]] on the golem. If you chose to bring a pickaxe and a [[bracelet of clay]], [[clay rocks]] can be found to the north-west, near the shore. The phoenix can be found there as well. 
**'''Optional''': Mine 5 clay for easy [[Desert Diary]], and steal the [[Desert Phoenix]]'s [[phoenix feather|feather]] while nearby.
**'''Optional''': Catch a [[Golden warbler|Golden Warbler]] near the [[Desert Phoenix]] with a [[Bird snare|Bird Snare]] (requiring Level 5 Hunter) for an easy Desert Diary task
*Talk to the golem again. {{Chat option|1How do I open the portal?}}
}}
